description: Parameters of Reactive Power Controller including REPCA1 and REECB1.

bus_control.description: ACBus identification number for voltage control. `0` identifies the local bus connected to this component.

from_branch_control.description: Monitored branch FROM bus identification number for line drop compensation (if 0 generator power will be used).

to_branch_control.description: Monitored branch TO bus identification number for line drop compensation (if 0 generator power will be used).

branch_id_control.description: Branch circuit id for line drop compensation (as a string). If 0 generator power will be used.

Ref_Flag.description: Flag for Reactive Power Control for REPCA1. `false`: Q-control, `true`: V-control.

PF_Flag.description: Flag for Power Factor Control for Outer Control of REECB1. `false`: Q-control, `true`: Power Factor Control.

V_Flag.description: Flag for Voltage Control for Outer Control of REECB1. `false`: Voltage Control, `true`: Q-Control.

T_fltr.description: Voltage or Q-power of REPCA Filter Time Constant. Units: s.

K_p.description: Reactive power PI control proportional gain.

K_i.description: Reactive power PI control integral gain.

T_ft.description: Reactive power lead time constant. Units: s.

T_fv.description: Reactive power lag time constant. Units: s.

V_frz.description: Voltage below which state xiq_oc (integrator state) is freeze.

R_c.description: Line drop compensation resistance (used when VC_Flag = 1).

X_c.description: Line drop compensation reactance (used when VC_Flag = 1).

K_c.description: Reactive current compensation gain (used when VC_Flag = 0).

e_lim.description: Upper/Lower limit on Voltage or Q-power deadband output `(e_min, e_max)`.

dbd_pnts.description: Voltage or Q-power error dead band thresholds `(dbd1, dbd2)`.

Q_lim.description: Upper/Lower limit on reactive power V/Q control in REPCA `(Q_min, Q_max)`.

T_p.description: Active power lag time constant in REECB. Used only when PF_Flag = 1. Units: s.

Q_lim_inner.description: Upper/Lower limit on reactive power input in REECB `(Q_min_inner, Q_max_inner)`. Only used when V_Flag = 1.

V_lim.description: Upper/Lower limit on reactive power PI controller in REECB `(V_min, V_max)`. Only used when V_Flag = 1.

K_qp.description: Reactive power regulator proportional gain (used when V_Flag = 1).

K_qi.description: Reactive power regulator integral gain (used when V_Flag = 1).

title: ReactiveRenewableControllerAB
